93: Such is the proper reading for this baraita in Sifrei in Parashat Re'eh Anokhi (Sifrei Devarim 121:1): "But if he shall say" -- unless he says it and repeats it. If he said [it] at the beginning of his six [years of service] but did not say [it] at the end of six [years of service], he is not pierced, as it is stated: "I will not go out free"; unless he says it when he leaves. If he said [it] at the end of six [years] but did not say it at the beginning of six [years] he is not pierced, as it is stated: "If the slave shall say" -- unless he states it while he is a slave. And this is its interpretation: if he said, and repeated, the two utterances at the beginning of the six [years], and did not say it at the end of six [years], he is not pierced, as is it stated: "I will not go out," which implies close to the [time of] going out. If he said it twice at the end of six, etc. -- unless he says it while he is [still] a slave.
